grammar_title: 同位语从句(the belief / fact / idea / news that …)
source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:同位语从句。抽象名词后用从句说明其具体内容;从句完整→用 that/whether/wh-(同位语);从句缺主语/宾语/状语→是定语从句(which/who/where/when)。句子地道、答案唯一。

points.point: 抽象名词 + that 同位语从句(从句完整,that 只连接、不作成分)
points.overview: belief/fact/idea/news/evidence/theory/hope/truth 等抽象名词后,接一个本身完整的句子来说明其内容,用 that 连接;that 在从句里不缺主语、宾语或状语,只起连接作用,不可用 which/what/where 等替换。

points.point: 同位语从句 vs 定语从句(完整→that;缺主/宾→which/who;缺地点/时间→where/when)
points.overview: 同一个抽象名词后,若后面的句子完整、只是补充说明其内容,用 that(同位语);若句子缺主语或宾语,则是定语从句,指物用 which、指人用 who;若只缺地点/时间状语,用 where/when。靠'从句缺不缺成分'来判断。

points.point: whether / what / how / why / when 引导的同位语从句
points.overview: question/problem 等表疑问的名词后,若内容是'是否',用 whether(不用 that);若从句缺名词性成分用 what;若只缺方式/原因/时间状语,用 how/why/when。靠从句'缺什么成分、表什么意思'唯一确定。

questions.stem: Columbus had a firm belief ____ the world was round.
questions.explanation: belief 后的句子 'the world was round' 本身完整、不缺任何成分,只补充说明这一信念的内容,用 that 连接;其余词都要求从句里缺一个成分,这里不缺。

questions.stem: There is strong evidence ____ Stonehenge was once used as a calendar.
questions.explanation: evidence 后的从句完整,只说明'证据的内容',用 that;which/what 需从句缺成分,where 需缺地点状语,都不符合。

questions.stem: Scientists put forward the idea ____ Earth's water was delivered by an asteroid.
questions.explanation: idea 后的句子完整,是对这一观点内容的说明,用 that;其余词在完整从句里没有可承担的成分。

questions.stem: The news ____ the Chang'e-4 probe had landed thrilled the whole country.
questions.explanation: news 后从句完整,说明消息的内容,用 that;which/what/whose 都要求从句缺成分。

questions.stem: Many people accept the theory ____ the giant statues were carved by hand.
questions.explanation: theory 后的从句完整,补充理论的具体内容,用 that。

questions.stem: Archaeologists made the discovery ____ the bluestones came from South Wales.
questions.explanation: discovery 后从句完整,说明发现的内容,用 that;此处不缺主宾,也不缺地点状语。

questions.stem: The fact ____ no one knows how the trilithons were raised still amazes visitors.
questions.explanation: fact 后从句完整,是对'事实'内容的说明,用 that。

questions.stem: We cannot ignore the truth ____ many ancient sites remain unexplained.
questions.explanation: truth 后从句完整,说明真相的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: There is a belief ____ aliens from another world helped build the monument.
questions.explanation: belief 后从句完整,补充说明这一信念,用 that。

questions.stem: Researchers reached the conclusion ____ the trench is the deepest place on Earth.
questions.explanation: conclusion 后从句完整,说明结论的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The suggestion ____ we should leave the ruins untouched sounds wise.
questions.explanation: suggestion 后从句完整,说明建议的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: Nobody can deny the fact ____ life exists even at the bottom of the ocean.
questions.explanation: fact 后从句完整,说明事实内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The old story spread the idea ____ a monster still lives in the lake.
questions.explanation: idea 后从句完整,说明这一说法的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: There is little evidence ____ the islanders ever reached South America.
questions.explanation: evidence 后从句完整,说明证据所指的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The report confirmed the news ____ a new species had been found in the forest.
questions.explanation: news 后从句完整,说明消息内容,用 that。

questions.stem: She had a strong feeling ____ the cave was hiding an ancient secret.
questions.explanation: feeling 后从句完整,说明这种感觉的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The hope ____ humans will one day explore the whole universe drives science on.
questions.explanation: hope 后从句完整,说明希望的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: Everyone was struck by the discovery ____ the deep trench was full of life.
questions.explanation: discovery 后从句完整,说明发现的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: He made the claim ____ he had crossed the great desert entirely alone.
questions.explanation: claim 后从句完整,说明所声称的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The belief ____ giants once ruled the island comes from old local legends.
questions.explanation: belief 后从句完整,说明这一信念的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The discovery ____ the trench supports life surprised many biologists.
questions.explanation: discovery 后的句子完整(不缺主宾或状语),是对发现内容的说明,属同位语从句,用 that。

questions.stem: Experts hold the view ____ ancient people had real astronomical knowledge.
questions.explanation: view 后从句完整,说明观点内容,是同位语从句,用 that。

questions.stem: There is growing evidence ____ the statues were moved by rocking them.
questions.explanation: evidence 后从句完整,说明证据内容,用 that(同位语)。

questions.stem: The idea ____ the limestone can cut through flesh keeps tourists away.
questions.explanation: idea 后从句完整,说明这一看法的内容,用 that。

questions.stem: No one doubts the fact ____ the rainforest hides uncontacted tribes.
questions.explanation: fact 后从句完整,说明事实内容,用 that。

questions.stem: We were excited by the news ____ a probe had reached the far side of the moon.
questions.explanation: news 后从句完整,说明消息内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The belief ____ the lake hides a monster still draws many visitors.
questions.explanation: belief 后从句完整,说明信念内容,用 that。

questions.stem: Scientists support the theory ____ water came to Earth from outer space.
questions.explanation: theory 后从句完整,说明理论内容,用 that。

questions.stem: The evidence ____ the archaeologists uncovered proved the city was real.
questions.explanation: 从句 'the archaeologists uncovered ____' 缺动词 uncovered 的宾语,是定语从句,指物用 which;who 指人、where/when 是状语都不对。

questions.stem: The deep trench ____ explorers have rarely reached is full of strange life.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 reached 的宾语,定语从句指物用 which。

questions.stem: The ancient symbols ____ they carved still puzzle researchers today.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 carved 的宾语,定语从句指物用 which。

questions.stem: The mysterious island ____ sailors named on Easter Day lies far out at sea.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 named 的宾语,定语从句指物用 which。

questions.stem: This is the remote valley ____ outsiders are not allowed to set foot.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、只缺地点状语(set foot ____),定语从句用 where;which/that 需缺主宾,这里不缺。

questions.stem: Madagascar has a reserve ____ huge needle-shaped rocks rise from the ground.
questions.explanation: 从句缺地点状语,定语从句用 where。

questions.stem: They reached the deep part of the ocean ____ the water pressure is deadly.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、只缺地点状语,用 where。

questions.stem: Salisbury Plain is the place ____ the ancient builders raised the huge stones.
questions.explanation: raised 已有宾语 the huge stones,从句只缺地点状语,用 where。

questions.stem: Around 2,000 BCE was the time ____ the builders rearranged the bluestones.
questions.explanation: rearranged 已有宾语,从句只缺时间状语,定语从句用 when。

questions.stem: Easter Day was the day ____ European sailors first saw the island.
questions.explanation: saw 已有宾语 the island,从句只缺时间状语,用 when。

questions.stem: The Bronze Age was the period ____ the largest stones were pulled to the site.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、只缺时间状语,用 when。

questions.stem: 2019 was the year ____ China's probe landed on the far side of the moon.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、只缺时间状语,用 when。

questions.stem: Scientists are studying the question ____ there is water on the moon.
questions.explanation: question 后的从句完整、内容是'是否有水',表疑问的同位语从句用 whether;that 不能引导表疑问的同位语从句,what/which 在完整从句里无成分可担。

questions.stem: There remains the question ____ Stonehenge was really used as a cemetery.
questions.explanation: question 后内容是'是否',用 whether;that 不可引导表疑问的同位语从句。

questions.stem: Experts discussed the question ____ aliens could ever have visited Earth.
questions.explanation: question 后表'是否'的疑问,用 whether。

questions.stem: The question ____ the old photographs are real has never been settled.
questions.explanation: question 后内容是'是否真实',用 whether。

questions.stem: Historians argue over the question ____ the Trojan War actually happened.
questions.explanation: question 后表'是否发生过',用 whether。

questions.stem: There is still the problem ____ such isolated tribes should be contacted.
questions.explanation: problem 后内容是'是否应该',表疑问的同位语从句用 whether。

questions.stem: I often wonder about the question ____ the universe will ever be fully known.
questions.explanation: question 后表'是否',用 whether。

questions.stem: There is the question ____ these strange symbols actually mean.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 mean 的宾语(……意味着什么),用 what;whether/how/that 都会使 mean 缺宾语而不通。

questions.stem: There is the question ____ the ancient builders were trying to record.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 record 的宾语,用 what。

questions.stem: The mystery ____ lies at the bottom of the trench fascinates scientists.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(……躺在海沟底部),用 what;who 指人不合,whether/that 无法充当主语。

questions.stem: The question ____ the giant statues were meant to show puzzles everyone.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 show 的宾语,用 what。

questions.stem: Researchers raised the question ____ the islanders ate during the hard times.
questions.explanation: 从句缺 ate 的宾语,用 what。

questions.stem: The question ____ the ancient people raised the trilithons remains unanswered.
questions.explanation: raised 已有宾语 the trilithons,从句只缺方式状语(怎样竖起),用 how;what/which/that 无名词性空缺可担。

questions.stem: Nobody could explain the question ____ the heavy bluestones were transported.
questions.explanation: 从句被动完整、只缺方式状语,用 how。

questions.stem: There is the question ____ early sailors found such a tiny island in the sea.
questions.explanation: found 已有宾语 such a tiny island,从句只缺方式状语,用 how。

questions.stem: The question ____ the builders devoted so much energy to the site puzzles us.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、只缺原因状语(为何投入这么多精力),用 why。

questions.stem: There remains the question ____ the islanders abandoned their stone giants.
questions.explanation: abandoned 已有宾语,从句只缺原因状语,用 why。

questions.stem: No one has answered the question ____ ancient people built the huge monument.
questions.explanation: built 已有宾语 the huge monument,从句只缺原因状语,用 why。

questions.stem: The question ____ the first humans reached the island is hard to answer.
questions.explanation: reached 已有宾语 the island,从句只缺时间状语,用 when。

questions.stem: Historians study the question ____ the second phase of building began.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、只缺时间状语(何时开始),用 when。
